pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

2. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 25

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

4. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

5. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15

6. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

7. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 23.6

8. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 36
   C. 6
   D. 18

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 22
   C. 15
   D. 30

10. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 m²

11. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 60
   C. 38
   D. 30

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
